entry.title: Cleveland Guardians staff and front office: Guardians assistant pitching coach Joe Torres has been named the lead pitching coach for Terry Francona's Reds.

Cleveland Guardians roster moves and needs: The Guardians: -Declined their half of Shawn Armstrong's 2027 mutual option -Declined Trevor Stephan's 2027 club option -Selected Milan Tolentino from Triple-A Columbus Armstrong and Stephan are now free agents. 40-man now at 36
Gavin Williams: The Guardians are mapping out their Game 6 pitching plan, but Gavin Williams is not an option to start on short rest, Stephen Vogt said.
